## Code findings

### 🔴 CRITICAL — SQL Injection — api/reports.py:142

Request-controlled `owner` is interpolated into the SQL string.

**Location:** `api/reports.py:142`
**Rule:** `py.sqli` · **Category:** Injection · **Confidence:** HIGH · [CWE-89](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html)

```python
owner = request.args["user"]
cur.execute(f"SELECT * FROM reports WHERE owner = '{owner}'")
rows = cur.fetchall()
```
> offending line: 142

**Vulnerable**

```python
cur.execute(f"... owner = '{owner}'")
```

**Secure**

```python
cur.execute("... owner = %s", (owner,))
```

Illustrative CVEs:

- [CVE-2019-19844](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-19844)
- [CVE-2021-23336](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-23336)

### 🔴 CRITICAL — Command Injection — worker/convert.js:88

Untrusted `src` is concatenated into a shell command.

**Location:** `worker/convert.js:88`
**Rule:** `js.command_injection` · **Category:** Injection · **Confidence:** MEDIUM · [CWE-78](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/78.html)

```javascript
exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
```
> offending line: 88

**Vulnerable**

```javascript
exec("ffmpeg -i " + src + " out.mp4")
```

**Secure**

```javascript
execFile("ffmpeg", ["-i", src, "out.mp4"])
```

### 🟠 HIGH — Hardcoded Credentials — config/settings.py:12

A live API key is committed to source control.

**Location:** `config/settings.py:12`
**Rule:** `py.hardcoded_secret` · **Category:** Secrets · **Confidence:** HIGH · [CWE-798](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/798.html)

```python
STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_abcd" + "••••"
```
> offending line: 12

**Vulnerable**

```python
STRIPE_KEY = "sk_live_********"
```

**Secure**

```python
STRIPE_KEY = os.environ["STRIPE_KEY"]
```

### 🟡 MEDIUM — Weak Password Hashing — auth/users.py:57

MD5 is unsuitable for password storage.

**Location:** `auth/users.py:57`
**Rule:** `py.weak_hash` · **Category:** Crypto · **Confidence:** MEDIUM · [CWE-328](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/328.html)

```python
digest = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
```
> offending line: 57

**Vulnerable**

```python
hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()
```

**Secure**

```python
bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt())
```

### 🔵 LOW — Open Redirect — web/views.py:203

User-supplied `next` is used as a redirect target unchecked.

**Location:** `web/views.py:203`
**Rule:** `py.open_redirect` · **Category:** Config · **Confidence:** LOW

```python
return redirect(request.args["next"])
```
> offending line: 203

**Vulnerable**

```python
return redirect(request.args["next"])
```

**Secure**

```python
return redirect(url_for(safe_endpoint(request.args)))
```
